title: Kenites
sourceLines: -1. A Canaanite tribe whose country was given to Abraham Ge 15:19; Nu 24:21-23
-2. The descendants of Jethro, a Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses
.Join the Israelites and live at Jericho Jud 1:16; 4:11; 1Ch 2:55
.Later in the wilderness of Judah Jud 1:16,17
.Jael, one of the, betrays and kills Sisera Jud 4:17-21
